
# Setup

Import necessary libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(readxl)
library(FNN)
```

Set default projection, tmap settings, and standard distance for deduplication (in metres)
```{r}
crs = 32636

tmap_mode(mode = "view")

priv_dist = 30
```

# Import Data

## Apac / Kwania Boundary
```{r}
apac_kwania = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Apac Kwania/ApacKwania.shp"), crs)
```


## Town Centres
```{r}
aduku = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Town Centres/aduku town centre/aduku_town_centre.shp"), crs)%>%
  mutate(town = "Aduku")%>%
  select(town)
apac = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Town Centres/apac town centre/apac_town_centre.shp"), crs)%>%
  mutate(town = "Apac")%>%
  select(town)

town_centres = rbind(aduku, apac)

rm(aduku, apac)
```

## Households
```{r}
households = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Households/households_raw.gpkg"), crs)%>%
  st_filter(., apac_kwania, .pred = st_intersects())%>%
  st_join(., town_centres)%>%
  mutate(hh_id = row_number())%>%
  select(hh_id, town)

nrow(households%>%filter(is.na(town)))/nrow(households)*100
```

## Water bodies
```{r}
water_bodies = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Water bodies/hotosm_uga_waterways_polygons_shp.shp"), crs)%>%
  st_filter(., st_buffer(apac_kwania, 1000))
```



## Schools

OpenStreetMap point data of schools downloaded from [HumData](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hotosm_uga_education_facilities)
```{r}
schools = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Schools/hotosm_uga_education_facilities_points_shp.shp"), crs)%>%
  st_filter(., apac_kwania, .pred = st_intersects())%>%
  st_join(., town_centres)%>%
  distinct(name, .keep_all = T)%>%
  mutate(school_id = row_number())

schools%>%data.frame()

tm_shape(schools)+
  tm_dots()+
  tm_basemap("Esri.WorldImagery")
```

## Healthcare facilities

Point data with lat/longs healthcare facilities from [Maina et al., 2019](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-019-0142-2#code-availability) and downloaded from [HumData](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/health-facilities-in-sub-saharan-africa)
```{r}
healthcare = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Healthcare Facilities/sub-saharan_health_facilities.shp"), crs)%>%
  st_filter(., apac_kwania, .pred = st_intersects())%>%
  st_join(., town_centres)%>%
  mutate(healthcare_id = row_number())

tm_shape(healthcare)+
  tm_dots()+
  tm_basemap("Esri.WorldImagery")
```


## Deduplicated water sources
```{r}
water_sources = st_transform(st_read("Processed data/water_source_dedups_apr21_2025.gpkg"))
```



# Preprocessing 

## Water Source Setup

We're going to create 9 sub-datasets of our master water source dataset: 3x deduplication versions (semi-conservative, aggressive, conservative) * 3x source types (all sources, non-surface sources, improved sources).
```{r}
variations = c("semi_all", "semi_nosurf", "semi_imp", "agg_all", "agg_nosurf", "agg_imp", "cons_all", "cons_nosurf", "cons_imp")
```

We're also going to separate out private and public sources, since we only want households nearby the private sources to have access to them in our proximity analyses. 
```{r}
private_sources = water_sources%>%filter(private == 1)

private_semi = private_sources%>%filter(delete_semi == F)
private_agg = private_sources%>%filter(delete_agg == F)
private_cons = private_sources

private_sources_dfs = list(private_semi, private_agg, private_cons)
```

For both private and public sources, we put the sub-datasets into lists we can loop through for each type of analysis. 
```{r}
public_sources = water_sources%>%filter(private == 0)

public_semi_all = public_sources%>%filter(delete_semi == F)
public_agg_all = public_sources%>%filter(delete_agg == F)
public_cons_all = public_sources

public_semi_nosurf = public_sources%>%filter(delete_semi == F & surface == 0)
public_agg_nosurf = public_sources%>%filter(delete_agg == F & surface == 0)
public_cons_nosurf = public_sources%>%filter(surface == 0)

public_semi_imp = public_sources%>%filter(delete_semi == F & improved == 1)
public_agg_imp = public_sources%>%filter(delete_agg == F & improved == 1)
public_cons_imp = public_sources%>%filter(improved == 1)

public_sources_dfs = list(public_semi_all, public_semi_nosurf, public_semi_imp, public_agg_all, public_agg_nosurf, public_agg_imp, public_cons_all, public_cons_nosurf, public_cons_imp)


```

## Households, Schools, and Healthcare

We generate a dataset of household coordinates, and we calculate the distance from each household to any surface water bodies (since this would count as 'all sources' in addition to any point water source data). 
```{r}
HH_coords = st_coordinates(households)%>%data.frame()%>%
  mutate(hh_id = row_number())

dist_to_lake = households%>%
  mutate(dist_to_lake = st_distance(geom, water_bodies)%>%apply(1, min),
         hh_id = row_number())%>%
  data.frame()%>%
  select(hh_id, dist_to_lake)
```

```{r}
school_coords = st_coordinates(schools)%>%data.frame()%>%
  mutate(school_id = row_number())

dist_to_lake = schools%>%
  mutate(dist_to_lake = st_distance(geometry, water_bodies)%>%apply(1, min),
         school_id = row_number())%>%
  data.frame()%>%
  select(school_id, dist_to_lake)
```

```{r}
healthcare_coords = st_coordinates(healthcare)%>%data.frame()%>%
  mutate(healthcare_id = row_number())

dist_to_lake = healthcare%>%
  mutate(dist_to_lake = st_distance(geometry, water_bodies)%>%apply(1, min),
         healthcare_id = row_number())%>%
  data.frame()%>%
  select(healthcare_id, dist_to_lake)
```

## Buffer Distances

Create a list of buffers at 100m intervals that we will use to find the # of sources within those distances for each household. Also a separate buffer for private sources.
```{r}
buffer30 = st_buffer(households, dist = priv_dist)

buffer100 = st_buffer(households, dist = 100)
buffer200 = st_buffer(households, dist = 200)
buffer300 = st_buffer(households, dist = 300)
buffer400 = st_buffer(households, dist = 400)
buffer500 = st_buffer(households, dist = 500)
buffer600 = st_buffer(households, dist = 600)
buffer700 = st_buffer(households, dist = 700)
buffer800 = st_buffer(households, dist = 800)
buffer900 = st_buffer(households, dist = 900)
buffer1000 = st_buffer(households, dist = 1000)
buffer_list = list(buffer100, buffer200, buffer300, buffer400, buffer500, buffer600, buffer700, buffer800, buffer900, buffer1000)
```

```{r}
school_buffer100 = st_buffer(schools, dist = 100)
school_buffer200 = st_buffer(schools, dist = 200)
school_buffer300 = st_buffer(schools, dist = 300)
school_buffer400 = st_buffer(schools, dist = 400)
school_buffer500 = st_buffer(schools, dist = 500)
school_buffer600 = st_buffer(schools, dist = 600)
school_buffer700 = st_buffer(schools, dist = 700)
school_buffer800 = st_buffer(schools, dist = 800)
school_buffer900 = st_buffer(schools, dist = 900)
school_buffer1000 = st_buffer(schools, dist = 1000)
school_buffer_list = list(school_buffer100, school_buffer200, school_buffer300, school_buffer400, school_buffer500, school_buffer600, school_buffer700, school_buffer800, school_buffer900, school_buffer1000)
```

Same for healtchare
```{r}
healthcare_buffer30 = st_buffer(healthcare, dist = priv_dist)

healthcare_buffer100 = st_buffer(healthcare, dist = 100)
healthcare_buffer200 = st_buffer(healthcare, dist = 200)
healthcare_buffer300 = st_buffer(healthcare, dist = 300)
healthcare_buffer400 = st_buffer(healthcare, dist = 400)
healthcare_buffer500 = st_buffer(healthcare, dist = 500)
healthcare_buffer600 = st_buffer(healthcare, dist = 600)
healthcare_buffer700 = st_buffer(healthcare, dist = 700)
healthcare_buffer800 = st_buffer(healthcare, dist = 800)
healthcare_buffer900 = st_buffer(healthcare, dist = 900)

```


# Distance Calculations

## Households

We are going to loop through our list of 9 public water source sub-datasets with different iterations of the distance analysis, as well as the corresponding sub-dataset of private sources. 

We record the distance from each household to the nearest 1) private source (only within the specified radius of 30m), 2) public source, and 3) in the analyses involving all sources (including surface water), to Lake Kwania. We then take the smallest distance for each household and add it as a new column to our original households dataframe. 

While in the loop, we also record the % of households within 100, 500, 1000, 1500, and 2000m of each type of source, saving those to another dataframe we will later use for visualisations. 
```{r}
percents_master = c()

for (i in c(1:length(public_sources_dfs))){
  pub_water_coords = st_coordinates(public_sources_dfs[[i]])%>%data.frame()

  if (i < 4){private_water_coords = st_coordinates(private_sources_dfs[[1]])%>%data.frame()}
  else if (i < 7){private_water_coords = st_coordinates(private_sources_dfs[[2]])%>%data.frame()}
  else {private_water_coords = st_coordinates(private_sources_dfs[[3]])%>%data.frame()}
    
  priv_dists = data.frame(get.knnx(private_water_coords, HH_coords%>%select(-hh_id), k=1))%>%
    mutate(hh_id = row_number())%>%
    filter(nn.dist <= priv_dist)%>%
    rename(priv_dist = nn.dist)%>%
    select(-nn.index)
  
  pub_dists = data.frame(get.knnx(pub_water_coords, HH_coords%>%select(-hh_id), k=1))%>%
    mutate(hh_id = row_number())%>%
    rename(pub_dist = nn.dist)%>%
    select(-nn.index)
  
  HH_dists = full_join(pub_dists, priv_dists, by = "hh_id")%>%
    mutate(min_dist = pmin(coalesce(priv_dist, Inf), coalesce(pub_dist, Inf)))
  
  if (i %in% c(1, 4, 7)){
    HH_dists = full_join(HH_dists, dist_to_lake, by = "hh_id")%>%
      mutate(min_dist = pmin(min_dist, dist_to_lake))}
  
  households[[paste0("dist_", variations[i])]] <- HH_dists$min_dist
  
  m100 = length(which(HH_dists$min_dist<=100))/length(HH_dists$min_dist)*100
  m500 = length(which(HH_dists$min_dist<=500))/length(HH_dists$min_dist)*100
  m1000 = length(which(HH_dists$min_dist<=1000))/length(HH_dists$min_dist)*100
  m1500 = length(which(HH_dists$min_dist<=1500))/length(HH_dists$min_dist)*100
  m2000 = length(which(HH_dists$min_dist<=2000))/length(HH_dists$min_dist)*100
  percents = c(m100, m500, m1000, m1500, m2000)
  
  percents_master = append(percents_master, percents)}

dedup = rep(c("Semi-Conservative", "Aggressive", "Conservative"), each = 15)
source_type = rep(rep(c("Any Source (incl. surf. water)", "Any Source (excl. surf. water)", "Improved Source"), each = 5), 3)
distance = rep(c("100", "500", "1000", "1500", "2000"), 9)

master = data.frame(dedup, source_type, distance, percents_master)
```

```{r}
master$source_type = factor(master$source_type, levels = c("Any Source (incl. surf. water)", "Any Source (excl. surf. water)", "Improved Source"))

agg = ggplot(master%>%filter(dedup == "Aggressive"), aes(distance, percents_master, fill = source_type))+
  geom_col(colour = "black", position = position_dodge(), alpha = 0.8)+
  theme_bw(base_size=14)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("coral", "skyblue3", "green3"))+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(hjust=0.5), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14), plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 8), legend.text = element_text(size=10), legend.title = element_text(size=12))+
  labs(y="Households Within Distance (%)", x="Distance to Water Source (m)", fill="Water Source Type")+
  theme(legend.position="bottom", legend.box = "vertical")+
  guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=3,byrow=TRUE))+
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("100", "500", "1000", "1500", "2000"), 
                   labels = c("100", "500", "1000", "1500", "2000"))+
  geom_text(aes(label=round(percents_master, 1)), position=position_dodge(width=0.9), vjust=-0.25, size = 3)

agg

#ggsave("distance_to_source_agg.jpg", agg, width = 7, height = 7)

cons = ggplot(master%>%filter(dedup == "Conservative"), aes(distance, percents_master, fill = source_type))+
  geom_col(colour = "black", position = position_dodge(), alpha = 0.8)+
  theme_bw(base_size=14)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("coral", "skyblue3", "green3"))+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(hjust=0.5), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14), plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 8), legend.text = element_text(size=10), legend.title = element_text(size=12))+
  labs(y="Households Within Distance (%)", x="Distance to Water Source (m)", fill="Water Source Type")+

  geom_text(aes(label=round(percents_master, 1)), position=position_dodge(width=0.9), vjust=-0.25, size = 3)
#ggsave("distance_to_source_cons.jpg", cons, width = 7, height = 7)

  geom_text(aes(label=round(percents_master, 1)), position=position_dodge(width=0.9), vjust=-0.25, size = 3)
```

# # of sources within radius

## Households
```{r}
means_master = c()

for (i in c(1:length(public_sources_dfs))){
  print(i)
  
  pub_water = public_sources_dfs[[i]]

  if (i < 4){private_water = private_sources_dfs[[1]]}
  else if (i < 7){private_water = private_sources_dfs[[2]]}
  else {private_water = private_sources_dfs[[3]]}
    
  priv_counts = data.frame(buffer30%>%mutate(priv_count = lengths(st_intersects(., private_water))))%>%select(hh_id, priv_count)
      
  for (j in 1:length(buffer_list)){
    pub_counts = buffer_list[[j]]%>%mutate(pub_count = lengths(st_intersects(., pub_water)))%>%select(hh_id, pub_count)
    total_counts = left_join(pub_counts, priv_counts, by = "hh_id")%>%
      mutate(total_count = pub_count + priv_count)
    
    households[[paste0("num_sources_", variations[i])]] <- total_counts$total_count
    
    means_master = append(means_master, mean(total_counts$total_count))}}

dedup = rep(c("Semi-Conservative", "Aggressive", "Conservative"), each = 30)
source_type = rep(rep(c("Any Source (incl. surf. water)", "Any Source (excl. surf. water)", "Improved Source"), each = 10), 3)
distance = rep(c("100", "200", "300", "400", "500", "600", "700", "800", "900", "1000"), 9)

master = data.frame(dedup, source_type, distance, means_master)

master$source_type = factor(master$source_type, levels = c("Any Source (incl. surf. water)", "Any Source (excl. surf. water)", "Improved Source"))
```
